✅ Correct Answer: A — Jean-Louis Schlesser

📖 Explanation:

At Monza in 1988, Ayrton Senna was leading comfortably on lap 49 of 51 when he attempted to lap Jean-Louis Schlesser at the Rettifilo chicane.

Schlesser, substituting for an unwell Nigel Mansell at Williams, locked up and clipped Senna's McLaren, stranding it on the kerb.

This single incident handed Gerhard Berger and Michele Alboreto a historic Ferrari 1-2 victory, preventing McLaren from sweeping all 16 races in 1988.
